fact: Cathedral of the Byzantine Empire for ~900 years; its 31 m dome was the largest interior space in the world for nearly 1,000 years; minarets added after the Ottoman conquest.
names_places: Istanbul (formerly Constantinople), Türkiye; commissioned by Emperor Justinian I; architects Anthemius of Tralles and Isidore of Miletus; Sultan Mehmed II converted it in 1453.
